subject: RDMA: Prevent IO for child process (#1244)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c, the RDMA transport, adding a guard that stops forked child processes (BGSAVE/AOF-rewrite children) from issuing RDMA IO on memory regions that are invalid in the child. This code is unreachable in the fuzzer's environment: RDMA is not compiled by default (BUILD_RDMA=no; it exists only as a loadable module needing librdmacm/libibverbs), loading it at runtime requires RDMA hardware or soft-RoCE which needs root, and every installed fuzzer component connects over TCP or unix sockets with no RDMA capability.
